A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] '''worker''' journeyed to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] to take part in its [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]]. Alongside a [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 1|group]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|of]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 4|fellow]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 5|workers]], the Wookiee gathered resources such as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to sustain a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|base]] on Alaris Prime. The worker also participated in [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|defending]] the base from an attack by native predatory [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]].

==Biography==
Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] worker of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] traveled to [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], to be part of the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization effort]] being undertaken by the Wookiees. Along with [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 1|two]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|other]] Wookiees, the worker went to a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|base]] to collect resources under instructions from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was sent by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to oversee the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization]] effort.<ref name="SW:GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
The workers began their task by harvesting [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] close to the [[command center]], the only building in the base. The workers soon had gathered enough food to allow the base to support a [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 4|fourth]] worker to join them, and once even more food was collected, [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 5|another]] worker arrived at the base. Jinn then instructed the workers to practice a drill in case they were attacked by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory species on Alaris Prime. The drill required the workers to cease activity and take refuge in the command center. After the drill was completed, the worker and the other Wookiees were told to focus their attention on gathering [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], a resource collected from [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that could be turned into [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] and used as building material.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Soon after, one of the leaders of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization]] of Alaris Prime, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], arrived at the command center. Simultaneously, four gundarks [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacked]] the base, forcing the worker and the other Wookiees to take shelter in the command center as they had previously practiced. With assistance from Chewbacca and using the building's [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] system, the workers were able to fight off the gundarks and [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. Chewbacca then explored the nearby area, finding deposits of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], which could be used as a form of currency in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]], a resource that could be processed into [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. The worker took part in gathering these resources for the base.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
The Wookiee wore a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and a piece of orange [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that covered the worker's torso and part of the worker's [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. The Wookiee also had access to different tools for gathering food, carbon, nova crystals, and ore.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee worker was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="SW:GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> This worker is featured in the second level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Gathering Resources," in which the Wookiee is one of three generic worker units that the player starts off with and uses throughout the level. This particular Wookiee stands directly in front of the command center when the level begins. The player may determine the order in which the workers collect the resources, so this article follows the order corresponding with Qui-Gon Jinn's instructions.<ref name="SW:GB" />
